IfritView's lens corrections (distortion, lateral chromatic aberration and
vignetting, for raws that carry none of their own) come from the lensfun
project's lens database: https://lensfun.github.io/

The database isn't part of IfritView. When a raw first needs it (and lens
downloads are allowed in the settings), IfritView downloads it whole from
lensfun's site, as lensfun's own lensfun-update-data does, and keeps it in
the user's cache folder. IfritView reads the database; it doesn't use or
include lensfun's library.

The lensfun database is copyright the lensfun contributors, and licensed
under the Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 3.0 Unported licence
(CC BY-SA 3.0): https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/
